actionResult.summary: 149 Apply implements most E2 requirements and repository regression is green, but review found two author-owned correctness blockers: the prospective three-file writer activation is scoped to the current Delivery Git-boundary projection and therefore reverts after the next Delivery Start; and formal Change Verification omits the changed a1-write-service regression from its selected Node test union.

reviewFindings.title: post-E2 three-file writer activation incorrectly expires at the next Delivery Start
reviewFindings.problem: The prospective writer gate checks only snapshot.gitBoundaries for the current Delivery. readGitBoundarySummaries(repoRoot, deliveryId) intentionally projects boundaries owned by that Delivery, so after 02 completes and a new Delivery starts, the E2 checkpoint is no longer present in the new Delivery snapshot. The same latest code therefore falls back to the pre-E2 full-entry/sidecar writer in 03 and later Deliveries.
reviewFindings.contractRef: specs/flowkit-formal-fact-reader-and-persistence/spec.md Requirement current structural ContextFile; specs/flowkit-lean-run-and-action-package/spec.md post-E2 prospective Apply; design.md Decision E2 checkpoint is sole writer transition boundary
reviewFindings.invariant: Once the recognized E2 Change Checkpoint has occurred, the prospective three-file writer is the current product writer for F1 and all later Changes/Deliveries; a later Delivery Start must not erase or reverse that product transition.
evidence: src/services/b1-run-execution-service.ts isPostE2ThreeFileWriterActive(snapshot) returns true only when snapshot.gitBoundaries contains the E2 change-checkpoint.
src/facts/git-boundary-reader.ts readGitBoundarySummaries(repoRoot, deliveryId) explicitly returns only boundaries owned by the requested Delivery.
A disposable Git history with 02 start → E2 checkpoint → 02 final → 03 start returns the E2 checkpoint for the 02 projection but only the 03 start boundary for the 03 projection.
03 implementation reference requires the 02 baseline to provide the prospective three-file Run writer; falling back to legacy sidecars in the next Delivery violates that handoff.
reviewFindings.impact: F1/G1 inside the current 02 Delivery may dogfood the new writer, but the first subsequent Delivery can silently revert to entry-workspace/verification sidecars. E2 would therefore fail its long-term normalization objective and hand 03 an unstable writer boundary.
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: Make post-E2 writer activation a repository-global monotonic fact derived from the recognized E2 checkpoint (or an equivalent already-authorized durable Git fact), not from the current Delivery-only boundary projection. Preserve the rule that production code presence alone cannot self-activate before the E2 checkpoint.
acceptance: Before the E2 checkpoint, E2 Apply/revise-apply still uses the pre-E2 sidecar protocol.
After the E2 checkpoint, F1/G1 use the three-file writer.
After a later Delivery Start, a new Apply/revise-apply still uses compact context identity and creates only action.md/context.json/result.json.
Add a regression spanning two Delivery Start boundaries so the writer cannot revert in 03 or later Deliveries.

reviewFindings.title: formal Change Verification does not execute a changed affected regression in the selected execution scope
reviewFindings.problem: 149 actualChangeSet includes tests/unit/services/a1-write-service.test.ts and Catalog maps tests/unit/services to the execution module, selecting tests-execution. However the physical resolver for tests-execution only runs two facts tests plus b1-run-execution-service.test.ts; it does not run a1-write-service.test.ts. Thus the formal verification can report tests-execution passed even when the changed regression itself fails.
reviewFindings.contractRef: specs/flowkit-change-verification-selection/spec.md generic deterministic selection and compatible affected test aggregation; tasks.md 5.1 and 7.1; design.md Decision affected execution aggregates compatible test files
reviewFindings.invariant: A formal affected verification check selected because of an actual changed path must execute a test set that covers that affected path/consumer relation; union/dedupe may reduce process count but must not drop required affected tests.
evidence: 149 verification-selection.json actualChangeSet explicitly contains modify tests/unit/services/a1-write-service.test.ts and seedModuleIds includes execution.
149 verification.md/evidence selected tests-execution, but its aggregated command omits tests/unit/services/a1-write-service.test.ts.

src/verification/change-selection/evidence.ts logicalNodeSelectors(tests-execution) returns only formal-fact-reader-e1-verification.test.ts, formal-fact-reader.test.ts, and b1-run-execution-service.test.ts.

In a disposable copy, adding an unconditional failing sentinel to a1-write-service.test.ts leaves the exact 149 selected Node union green (351/351), while running a1-write-service.test.ts directly fails. This proves the formal selected evidence can miss a regression in its own actualChangeSet.
Independent repository regression currently passes 752/752, so this is a selection-authority correctness defect rather than a claim that the present a1 assertion is failing.
reviewFindings.impact: Change Verification can publish passed while a changed affected test is red. That breaks the generic Verification guarantee and makes the terminal verification binding insufficient for Reviewer/archive trust.
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: Make logical affected-test resolution preserve the complete required affected test union for selected modules/paths while still deduplicating compatible Node execution. The concrete implementation may reuse the existing affected-scope resolver or another deterministic mapping, but must not omit changed/required affected regressions.
acceptance: For an actualChangeSet containing tests/unit/services/a1-write-service.test.ts, formal Change Verification executes that test (or a formally equivalent complete affected test set that contains it).
A failing sentinel in that changed regression makes the selected tests-execution evidence fail rather than pass.
The compatible Node union remains deduplicated and does not regress to one process per logical module.
Re-run E2 Change Verification and bind the corrected passed evidence before re-review.
